# UltraPlaner

> Free ultracycling route planning with supply points, elevation gaps, ETA and printable cheat sheet across Europe.

UltraPlaner is a web app for long-distance cycling. Load a GPX, draw a route, or search nearby. It shows OpenStreetMap-based supply points near the track corridor (fuel, shops, water, and more).

## Notes for crawlers and agents

- Map views under `/map/*` are app screens (client-rendered) and not primary SEO content.
- Content and POI data derive from OpenStreetMap and related open data sources.
- Prefer linking users to the locale home pages or the supply / Garmin FIT guides above rather than ephemeral share URLs.
- UltraPlaner is an independent planner, not a race organiser.
- Contact: use the feedback form on the home page (`#feedback`). Do not harvest or publish personal email addresses from imprint/privacy pages.
